rows.en: What is this racket!! What's going on!!
Sir! We've captured the kaijin in question and brought it here!!
Oh!! Well done. So this is the Armored Samurai Kaijin!!
I hear he's quite powerful... and that he's been running wild without belonging to anyone?
Our apologies. We'll prepare to extract his Core Medals at once!!
Wait! We can't handle him in this state. Make him fight the heroes and wear him down.
Sir! Then we'll lure them here right away.
No, there's no need for that. I anticipated this and have already made my move.
Anyone who gets fooled is an idiot!! Ukikiiiiiii!!
As expected of a master of the Kaima ninja arts. So quick on his feet!
I know, I'll try teaming up the samurai kaijin and the ninja kaijin.
Armored Samurai Kaijin!! Gaina Ninpo!! Dispose of the Lost Heroes!!
Ugh... So this is the end...
The Armored Samurai Kaijin's body crumbled into a heap of Cell Medals.
Three Core Medals flew out from inside it!
The Core Medals have appeared. Those are mine...!!
Ikadevil swiftly caught the three Core Medals.
Ohh!! I can see crests of a scorpion, a crab and a shrimp... So this is a Core Medal.
You lot have saved me a lot of trouble!!
You!! You planned this from the start!!
...!? The scent of a Yummy...? No, this is...
It's this room. I can sense a Greeed...
{8074} and the team peeked into the room through the small window in the door...
Mezool looked terribly weak, muttering something as if delirious.
...Kazari... I won't forgive you... Medals... medals... my Core Medals...
Looks like being betrayed by Kazari hit her pretty hard.
She's lost almost all her Core Medals. She can barely hold her body together.
Well, we can't just leave her like this!
{8074} and the team peeked into the room through the small window in the door...
It looks like weapons, ammunition and the like are stored inside.
Just as I expected. There should be some small bombs in here we can use.
Just like Rider 1 said! There should be some small bombs in here we can use.
Woo-hoo! There's gotta be a bomb or two in here!
Bingo! There should be some small bombs in here we can use.
It's just like our senior, Rider 1, said! There should be some small bombs in here we can use.
Just like Rider 1 said! There's gotta be some small bombs in here we can use.
Just as Rider 1 said! There should be some small bombs in here we can use.
An armory, huh... There should be some small bombs in here we can use.

notes.note: Labelled ???; read as the restrained Armored Samurai Kaijin struggling (continues 0331 #0.146-0.152 in story_055).
Glossary gives the kaijin g=m, so 'he'; the grunt's report in #0.155 keeps 'it' for 'the kaijin'.
Echoes his earlier 'Who killed me' (story_055 #0.148): he takes Ikadevil for his killer, hence 'So it was you'.
Gaina Ninpo gloating after a trick; the deception itself falls in #0.164-0.166, which are not in this slice. Screech per glossary 'Ukikii!'.
#0.168-0.177 are unlabelled party-leader hit reactions (first labelled ?party); identical Japanese gets identical English. #0.169 'kono yarou' rendered 'You bastard' (not softened).
Tenchu rendered 'Heaven's judgment' with drawn-out vowel.
Unlabelled; read as Ankh (he reacts at #0.189 and #0.193).
Scorpion/crab/shrimp = the Shocker Core Medals from the OOO movie; Ankh's confused reaction (#0.193) fits since they aren't Greeed medals he knows.
Unlabelled; Ikadevil leaving with the medals (Ankh answers at #0.196).
Source kanji reads 'phrase', an evident typo/mis-decode for the kanji 'smell'; rendered 'scent'.
Unlabelled; read as Ankh, continuing into his labelled #0.8. Mezool g=f -> 'her'.

#0.9-0.19 are 11 party-leader variants. #0.12 (casual) and #0.14 (polite) both 'Let's help her!'; politeness not expressible. #0.15-0.19 'tasukeru no ka' read as the leader questioning whether they're really saving a Greeed: 'We're helping her!?' / 'Are we helping her?'.
#0.1-0.11 are leader variants; #0.3 is the rough one.

#0.19-0.29 (into story_057) are leader variants recalling Rider 1's guess that the enemy stores weapons further in (story_055 #0.120-0.123). #0.19 'as I expected' may be Rider 1's own slot. #0.23 '1-go senpai' -> 'our senior, Rider 1' per glossary/precedent; #0.25 '-san' dropped; #0.21 rough 'a bomb or two'.

report: All 80 rows translated. Uncertain: 0331 #0.153 (??? = struggling samurai kaijin), #0.191/#0.195 unlabelled (Ankh/Ikadevil inferred), 0333 #0.1 typo'd kanji (smell), 0334 #0.7 unlabelled (Ankh), 0334 #0.15-0.19 read as the leader questioning the rescue. No new names; Shocker medal crests rendered scorpion/crab/shrimp.
